correctness.rationale: The derived subspace is characteristic and the alternating bracket forces the lower diagonal block to be the exterior square of A; all q^9 central shears are permitted. The natural dimension-three exterior duality identifies that block with det(A) times the inverse transpose, so its 1-eigenspace dimension equals the d-eigenspace dimension of A even for nonsemisimple A. At d=1 the two graded dimensions agree. The k-dimensional incidence count has q^{k(3-k)} free coordinates and an SL determinant fiber if the complement is nonzero. At d!=1 an ordered pair of eigen-subspaces of dimensions k,l is disjoint; the second subspace has q^{kl} graph lifts after its projection in V/U is chosen. The determinant on the remaining r-dimensional block is d^{1-l}, and there are q^{(k+l)r} off-diagonal choices. At r=0 exactly d^l=d is required, allowing l=1 and additionally l=3 precisely at d=-1 distinct from 1. The single and product Gaussian inversions follow from the alternating Gaussian sum for each interval of the subspace lattice. The block-triangular fixed-point-free criterion holds without asserting additivity of the fixed-space dimension. Expanding the zero-dimension Gaussian sums, the d=1 contribution is q^3(q+1)(q^4-2q^3+2); the d!=1 contribution is q^3(q^2+q+1)(q^3-3q^2+5)-q^3 times the indicator of d=-1 distinct from 1 (with the subtraction applied only to the last term). Summing gives the claimed parity correction. An independent rational-canonical-type calculation reproduced the same polynomial symbolically and the base counts 48, 4860, 98048 at q=2,3,4; the replay is given in the implication check. The frozen script was inspected, not run. For q=2 the two irreducible cubics alone give 2|GL3(2)|/7=48; the smaller Heisenberg algebra has its whole derived line fixed because det is always 1 over F2.

evidence: Take cycle-index degree 3. For each type (lambda_phi), read d=(-1)^3 times the product of phi(0) raised to |lambda_phi|. Keep terms with lengths a,b for phi=X-1,X-d respectively, using the same partition at d=1. Sum their weights and multiply by q^9 times |GL3(q)|. This yields every coefficient in the original law without exhaustively enumerating matrices.

Replay of the closed coefficient: set h=q-1, s=q-2, G=|GL3(q)|, e=1 at odd q and 0 otherwise. Cubic irreducibles contribute (q^3-q)/(3(q^3-1)) to the proportion. A quadratic irreducible and a linear root contribute s(q^2-2q+e)/(2(q^2-1)h): the linear root must differ from 1 and the quadratic norm from 1. The norm-one subgroup has q+1 elements of which 1+e lie in F_q, so (q-e)/2 monic irreducible quadratics are excluded.

In the split cases all three roots avoid 1 and no pair multiplies to 1. All-equal root labels number s-e; two-equal root labels number (s-e)(s-2); three-distinct unordered labels number binom(s,3)-(s-e)(s-2)/2. Their cycle-index weights per label are respectively 1/G+1/(q^3 h^2)+1/(q^2 h), 1/(q h^2)+1/(q h^3(q+1)), and 1/h^3. Adding the five contributions and simplifying with e symbolic gives exactly the displayed proportion. Multiplying by G reproduces the base counts, and by G q^9 the Lie automorphism counts.

originality.rationale: The strongest prior source is the fully weighted Kung–Stong cycle index, explicitly presented in Fulman (1997) §3.2. It gives exact weights for each irreducible-primary partition family, not just a list of possible normal forms. The two graded dimensions and determinant are labels on those very types, so coefficient filtering and the constant q^9 shear factor give the complete rank-three law without a new enumeration theorem. The zero-zero specialization also reduces directly to five standard type families, yielding exactly the advertised closed polynomial and parity term. The Gaussian-binomial formula supplies a different, concise expression, but the census and its closed specialization are mechanically implied. A later distinct Resultary record prints the same fixed-point-free polynomial; its date is not the basis of the failure.
residual_risks: The review establishes coverage by an exact specialization, not priority of the displayed Gaussian-binomial expression or a claim about relationships between the two catalogue records.
